title: Archway over Paranal
caption: The Milky Way arching over the Paranal Residencia, Paranal Observatory, Chile
celestial: Photograph taken at Paranal Observatory, Chile

recognition.text: Published in the ESO image archive. No published rating.

story: The Milky Way arches across the sky above ESO's Paranal Observatory in this panorama. Up from the desert in the foreground rises the familiar glass dome of the Paranal Residencia.

Toward the horizon, the sky is tinged with a mixture of soft red and green hues. This glow is called airglow, a faint light given off by the Earth's upper atmosphere itself. It fills the lower sky near the horizon, over the open desert landscape.

Set within those glows are the Large and Small Magellanic Clouds, two small galaxies that are neighbors of the Milky Way. Below them, under the arch of our own galaxy, sits the Residencia's rounded glass dome, with the observatory's telescopes nearby to study that same sky.

understand.summary: This is a panoramic landscape photograph at ESO's Paranal Observatory, in visible light. The camera settings and color processing are not published.
understand.eye: A camera exposure can gather far more light than the eye, so the colors of the airglow and the Milky Way may look stronger than they would to someone standing there.
